In this image, the tip appears slightly melted or blunt, lacking the crisp mechanical definition of a real bird. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed this (reporting 'null'), likely because it focuses on global noise/blur rather than micro-texture realism. However, visual inspection confirms the Router's finding of slight unnatural smoothness/clumping.

Overall, the artifacts are subtle but present, primarily affecting the fine details of the bill and feathers.
